name: remotion-example
description: Videos rendered with Remotion from an executable-stories run and a showcase recording

scripts.report: executable-stories format reports/raw-run.json --format story-report-json --output-dir public --output-name index
scripts.render: remotion render CheckoutStates out/checkout-states.mp4 && remotion render CatalogueSearch out/catalogue-search.mp4 && remotion render DemoRecording out/demo-recording.mp4 && remotion render Walkthrough out/walkthrough.mp4 && remotion render ArticleWalkthrough out/article-walkthrough.mp4
scripts.video: pnpm test && pnpm report && pnpm record && pnpm walkthrough && pnpm render
scripts.walkthrough: playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts && executable-stories video reports/walkthrough/raw-run.json --output-dir public
